Record Class Deck

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.adsl.server.model.board.Deck
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record Deck(ArrayList<Card> cards) extends Record implements Serializable
The draw pile used during a game. Cards are ordered by era (era 1 first, era 3 last, final-event cards after era 3). Within each era the order is shuffled at creation time.

    • createDeck

      public static Deck createDeck(ArrayList<Set<Card>> cards)
      Creates a shuffled deck from the list of era sets returned by BoardConfigLoader.getCards(). Cards within each era are shuffled independently before being appended.
      Parameters:
      cards - list of card sets ordered by era (index 0 = era 1, …)
      Returns:
      a new Deck ready to draw from

    • isNewEra

      public boolean isNewEra(int currentEra)
      Returns true if the top card of the deck belongs to an era higher than currentEra, signalling that an era transition should occur. Only call this when the deck is non-empty.
      Parameters:
      currentEra - the era the game is currently in (1–3)
      Returns:
      true if the next card is from a newer era
